_doc: make car: CAR on 16 clusters (reference mapping of Shi et al. and the contraction criteria) and the criterion of application E on 4 clusters. Paths relative to apps/. load_capacity_cycles: cycles of a 1 MHz processor over the 1 s hyperperiod of CAR (the WCETs of shi-2010.txt assume 1 MHz). spiral: Spiral Mapping of CAR (steps 1 and 2 of the analysis flow) on the width x height mesh; permutations: random placements for the payload x hops comparison, drawn with random.Random(seed).
